name: APICon Conference
tagline: Building reliable APIs for East African products

venue.name:
孔子学院
Confucius Institute at UDSM
venue.description: APICon takes place at the Confucius Institute at the University of Dar es Salaam. Registration details will be posted at the entrance.

speakers.name: Amina Juma
speakers.bio: Amina designs payment APIs used by banks and fintechs across East Africa. She focuses on idempotency, versioning, and making failure modes obvious to client teams.

speakers.name: Daniel Owuor
speakers.bio: Daniel works on developer platforms and OpenAPI-first services. He previously led API gateway work for a regional telecom and now helps teams ship safer public APIs.

speakers.name: Grace Mwakasege
speakers.bio: Grace leads teams building health-data integrations. She cares about consent, audit trails, and APIs that hospitals can operate without a dedicated platform crew.

speakers.name: Joseph Kimani
speakers.bio: Joseph teaches practical API design through workshops and office hours. He is known for turning vague product requirements into clear resource models.

speakers.name: Lina Hassan
speakers.bio: Lina specializes in OAuth, token hygiene, and abuse prevention. She helps product teams add authentication without making partner onboarding painful.

sessions.title: Opening keynote: APIs that survive real traffic
sessions.description: A look at the API failures that show up only after launch, and the design habits that prevent them. We will cover timeouts, retries, and what partners actually need in an error body.

sessions.title: Workshop: Designing with OpenAPI before you write handlers
sessions.description: A hands-on session on writing a contract first, generating types, and keeping docs honest. Bring a laptop. We will sketch a small payments API together.

sessions.title: Integrating hospital systems without leaking patient data
sessions.description: Grace walks through a regional health integration: scopes, audit logs, and how to say no to a field that should never leave the clinic.

sessions.title: OAuth for partner APIs that non-specialists can ship
sessions.description: A practical tour of authorization code, client credentials, and refresh tokens. We will also talk about the mistakes that lock partners out on day one.

sessions.title: API versioning without splitting the team in two
sessions.description: When to bump a version, when to add a field, and how to sunset an endpoint that still has production traffic.

sessions.title: Developer experience office hours
sessions.description: Bring a confusing error message, a messy endpoint, or a partner complaint. We will review a few examples live and leave with a checklist you can reuse.

sessions.title: Closing panel: What East African API teams should build next
sessions.description: Speakers compare notes on payments, health, identity, and the documentation that actually gets read. Audience questions welcome.
